proposal:
build_mastr.py MANUAL:
    'Erbes-Büdesheim wind farm': (['Windpark Offenheim'],   # 5 部 Vestas V112（3,075 kW，2013-12 至 2014-02），15.375 MW；營運公司 ERG Wind Erbes Büdesheim（Standort Offenheim）
                                  'https://www.thewindpower.net/windfarm_en_24358.php'),
farm_cleanup.py RULES:
    fix('DEU', 'Erbes-Büdesheim wind farm', G,
        'GEM 的 15 MW 取自 The Wind Power 的「5 部 Vestas V112、15,375 kW」（Erbes-Büdesheim／Offenheim／Nack），就是 MaStR 的「Windpark Offenheim」：5 部 V112，2013 年 12 月至 2014 年 2 月併網，'
        '營運公司 ERG Wind Erbes Büdesheim GmbH & Co. KG, Standort Offenheim；GEM 的 2012 年與座標取自村北另一群 2012 年的 Senvion 3.4M104，改為 2013 年、座標移到這 5 部的中心',
        'GEM’s 15 MW comes from The Wind Power’s “5 Vestas V112, 15,375 kW” (Erbes-Büdesheim/Offenheim/Nack), i.e. MaStR’s “Windpark Offenheim”: 5 V112 connected December 2013 – February 2014, '
        'operated by ERG Wind Erbes Büdesheim GmbH & Co. KG, Standort Offenheim; GEM’s 2012 and its point come from a different group of 2012 Senvion 3.4M104 north of the village, so the year becomes 2013 and the point moves to the centre of the five',
        'https://www.thewindpower.net/windfarm_en_24358.php', year=2013, lat=49.741, lon=8.026),
note_zh: GEM 這筆的容量（15 MW）與營運者取自 The Wind Power 第 24358 號頁面：第 2 部分是 Erbes-Büdesheim／Offenheim／Nack 的 5 部 Vestas V112、15,375 kW（第 1 部分另有 3 部、9,225 kW）。MaStR 的「Windpark Offenheim」正好是 5 部 3,075 kW 的 V112（SEE948198937756、SEE949893395193 於 2013-12-30，SEE968385814714、SEE979394705078、SEE994514686785 於 2014 年 1–2 月），合計 15.375 MW，中心 49.7411, 8.0258；wind-turbine.com 列出的營運公司「ERG Wind Erbes Büdesheim GmbH & Co. KG, Standort Offenheim」也是 15.375 kW（應為 MW 級的 15,375 kW）、約 2013 年起。旁邊的「Windpark Nack」是另 4 部 V112（12.3 MW），不是這筆。GEM 的 2012 年與「精確」座標 49.7570, 8.0561 卻取自 MaStR（第 [1] 號出處），落在村北 juwi 的 Senvion 3.4M104 群（「Windpark Erbes-Büdesheim」2 部，2012 年），turbines_de.json 也因此把這筆對到那裡的 4 部（2012–2016）。加上 MANUAL 後 Offenheim 這群不再另加成一座 MaStR 風場（消除重複），原本配到的 Senvion 等機組放回去照常處理。
note_en: GEM’s capacity (15 MW) and operator come from The Wind Power page 24358: part 2 is 5 Vestas V112 at Erbes-Büdesheim/Offenheim/Nack, 15,375 kW (part 1 is another 3 units, 9,225 kW). MaStR’s “Windpark Offenheim” is exactly 5 V112 of 3,075 kW (SEE948198937756 and SEE949893395193 on 30 Dec 2013; SEE968385814714, SEE979394705078 and SEE994514686785 in Jan–Feb 2014), 15.375 MW in all, centred at 49.7411, 8.0258; wind-turbine.com lists its operator “ERG Wind Erbes Büdesheim GmbH & Co. KG, Standort Offenheim” with 15,375 kW from about 2013. The neighbouring “Windpark Nack” is another 4 V112 (12.3 MW), not this record. GEM’s 2012 and its ‘exact’ point 49.7570, 8.0561 come from MaStR (its reference [1]) and fall among juwi’s Senvion 3.4M104 north of the village (“Windpark Erbes-Büdesheim”, 2 units, 2012), which is why turbines_de.json matched the record to 4 units there (2012–2016). With the MANUAL entry the Offenheim group is no longer added as a separate MaStR farm (removing the duplicate), and the units matched before go back to the pool.
why: New route vs round 12: GEM's own references (gem.wiki) show the 15 MW came from The Wind Power page 24358 (part 2: 5 x V112, 15,375 kW) while the year and point came from MaStR; MaStR unit list confirms which group is 5 x V112. KGAL could not be confirmed (thewindpower now shows owner ND; fieldfisher 403) so the owner field is left alone.

build_mastr.py MANUAL:
    'Lütjenholm wind farm': (['WPL'],   # MaStR 的「WPL」＝Windpark Lütjenholm：4 部 Senvion 3.4M104，2013 年（Bargum／Lütjenholm；OpenStreetMap 風場範圍同一批機位）
                             'https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/14965140'),
farm_cleanup.py RULES:
    fix('DEU', 'Lütjenholm wind farm', G,
        '「Windpark Lütjenholm」是 4 部 Senvion（REpower）3.4M104、13.6 MW，2013 年併網，就是 MaStR 的「WPL」（Bargum／Lütjenholm，OpenStreetMap 的風場範圍是同一批機位）；'
        'GEM 的座標在東方約 4 km 的 Goldelund，那裡是另一座 BWP Veer Dörper，改到這 4 部的中心',
        '“Windpark Lütjenholm” is 4 Senvion (REpower) 3.4M104, 13.6 MW, connected in 2013: MaStR’s “WPL” at Bargum/Lütjenholm (the OpenStreetMap plant has the same turbine positions); '
        'GEM’s point is about 4 km east at Goldelund, where the separate BWP Veer Dörper stands, so it moves to the centre of the four',
        'https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/14965140', lat=54.674, lon=9.036),
note_zh: GEM 的 Lütjenholm（14 MW、2013 年、業主 GEO mbH、營運者「Windpark Lütjenholm」）的容量與業主取自 GEO 的參考案例頁（其中有「4 x REpower 3.4M104 // 2013 年 4 月商轉」）。MaStR 的「WPL」是 4 部 Senvion 3.4M104（SEE944239630990、SEE912529897798 於 2013-03，SEE919010704498 於 2013-04，SEE923469471689 於 2013-09），13.48 MW，在 Bargum／Lütjenholm，中心 54.6736, 9.0357。OpenStreetMap 的風場範圍 relation 14965140「Windpark Lütjenholm」（plant:output 13.6 MW）包含 4 部 Senvion 3.4 MW、start_date 2013 的風機，座標與這 4 部 MaStR 機組一致（例：54.67747, 9.03733＝SEE919010704498）；OpenInfraMap 與 The Wind Power 也都寫 13.6 MW、4 部 3.4M104。GEM 的「精確」座標 54.6748, 9.0976 附近（Goldelund）沒有任何 MaStR 機組，最近的是 1.8 km 外 2014 年的 BWP Veer Dörper。現在 turbines_de.json 把這筆對到 2020–2025 年的 3 部 Nordex N133，是別的機組。
note_en: GEM’s Lütjenholm (14 MW, 2013, owner GEO mbH, operator “Windpark Lütjenholm”) takes its capacity and owner from GEO’s reference list (which has “4 x REpower 3.4M104 // commissioned April 2013”). MaStR’s “WPL” is 4 Senvion 3.4M104 (SEE944239630990 and SEE912529897798 in March 2013, SEE919010704498 in April, SEE923469471689 in September), 13.48 MW at Bargum/Lütjenholm, centred at 54.6736, 9.0357. OpenStreetMap relation 14965140 “Windpark Lütjenholm” (plant:output 13.6 MW) holds 4 Senvion 3.4 MW turbines with start_date 2013 at the same positions as these MaStR units (e.g. 54.67747, 9.03733 = SEE919010704498); OpenInfraMap and The Wind Power also give 13.6 MW, 4 × 3.4M104. There is no MaStR unit near GEM’s ‘exact’ point 54.6748, 9.0976 (Goldelund); the nearest is BWP Veer Dörper (2014), 1.8 km away. turbines_de.json now matches the record to 3 Nordex N133 of 2020–2025, which are other turbines.
why: OSM relation tags (name=Windpark Lütjenholm, plant:output:electricity=13.6 MW, member nodes Senvion 3.4 MW start_date 2013) read from https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/relation/14965140/full; the API XML keeps the values in attributes, so check_quotes cannot quote it — OpenInfraMap's page for the same relation is quoted instead.

proposal:
farm_cleanup.py NOT_DUP:
    ('DEU', 'WP Kail'):
        ('MaStR 的「WP Kail」是 2025 年在 Kail／Kaisersesch 併網的 3 部 Nordex（2 部 N149/4.5 MW、1 部 N131/3.9 MW，12.9 MW）；GEM 的 Zettingen（Gamesa 開發、2010 年售予 IKEA）對到的是 3 km 外 2009–2010 年的 6 部 Nordex N90：不同風場',
         'MaStR’s “WP Kail” is 3 Nordex turbines connected in 2025 at Kail/Kaisersesch (2 N149/4.5 MW and an N131/3.9 MW, 12.9 MW); GEM’s Zettingen (developed by Gamesa, sold to IKEA in 2010) matches the 6 Nordex N90 of 2009–2010 3 km away: different farms',
         'https://www.marktstammdatenregister.de/MaStR/Datendownload'),
farm_cleanup.py RULES (optional, fills the missing year):
    fix('DEU', 'Zettingen wind farm', G,
        '補上商轉年 2009：MaStR 的「Zettingen」6 部 Nordex N90 中 5 部 2009 年 12 月、1 部 2010 年 6 月併網（Gamesa 開發，2010 年 9 月售予 IKEA）',
        'Start year 2009 added: of MaStR’s six Nordex N90 “Zettingen”, five were connected in December 2009 and one in June 2010 (developed by Gamesa, sold to IKEA in September 2010)',
        'https://www.marktstammdatenregister.de/MaStR/Datendownload', year=2009),
note_zh: 本站資料裡 GEM 的 Zettingen 沒有商轉年（年份不詳），不是 2025 年；GEM 的出處是 Gamesa 2010 年 9 月把在 Zettingen 等地開發的風場賣給 IKEA 的新聞，以及 The Wind Power 的「Zettingen I」（Brachtendorf／Zettingen，Nordex N90），GEM 的「精確」座標 50.2183, 7.2105 也在 MaStR「Zettingen」群（6 部 N90，2009-12 至 2010-06，15 MW，中心 50.2191, 7.2059）裡。現在 turbines_de.json 對到的就是這 6 部，沒有錯。MaStR 的「WP Kail」在東南方約 3 km 的 Kail／Kaisersesch，是 2025 年 9–10 月併網的 3 部新機（SEE950897648765、SEE950912477769、SEE997361980594），與 Zettingen 不是同一座。
note_en: In the site data GEM’s Zettingen has no start year (year unknown), not 2025. GEM cites Gamesa’s September 2010 sale to IKEA of wind farms it had developed, Zettingen among them, and The Wind Power’s “Zettingen I” (Brachtendorf/Zettingen, Nordex N90); GEM’s ‘exact’ point 50.2183, 7.2105 also lies in MaStR’s “Zettingen” group (6 N90, December 2009 – June 2010, 15 MW, centred at 50.2191, 7.2059). turbines_de.json already matches the record to these six, which is right. MaStR’s “WP Kail”, about 3 km south-east at Kail/Kaisersesch, is 3 new turbines connected in September–October 2025 (SEE950897648765, SEE950912477769, SEE997361980594), not the Zettingen farm.
why: MaStR facts plus GEM's own sources; capacity left as GEM's 13 MW (MaStR 15 MW with 2.5 MW N90; The Wind Power 11.5 MW with 5 x N90/2300) because the sources disagree.

note_en: GEM’s Bornstedt-Holdenstedt (12 MW, owner MVV Energie): MVV’s onshore wind map gives “Windpark Holdenstedt-Bornstedt” 8 turbines and 12 MW (marker 51.457, 11.460); part 2 of The Wind Power’s Bornstedt-Holdenstedt is likewise 8 GE 1.5sl at Allstedt, 12,000 kW. MaStR’s “Windpark Holdenstedt-Bornstedt” is exactly 8 GE 1.5sl (1.5 MW) connected on 12–17 July 2006, centred at 51.4589, 11.4664; turbines_de.json already matches these eight, so the match is right and only GEM’s 2010 (taken from MaStR, probably the nearby 2010 MD77 or V90 units) is wrong. MaStR’s “WP Mittelhausen” is 6 Vestas V90 connected April–June 2010 (12 MW, centred at 51.4492, 11.4725): different model, count and year, so a different farm.
why: MVV map data (archived page GEM cites) and The Wind Power page 3743; commissioning dates from MaStR.

item: 1f. Schülp and Büttler Balje (GEM) vs Bürgerwindpark Norddeich (MaStR)
farm: Schülp wind farm / Büttler Balje wind farm / Bürgerwindpark Norddeich
proposal:
build_mastr.py MANUAL:
    'Schülp wind farm': (['Windpark Schülp', 'Windpark Schülp III'],   # wpd 的 Schülp：5 部 Enercon E-70，2014 年（MaStR 分成兩群；Schülp III 群裡 2016 年那部＝wpd 的 Schülp II）
                         'https://www.wpd.de/en/projects/references/'),
farm_cleanup.py NOT_DUP:
    ('DEU', 'Bürgerwindpark Norddeich'):
        ('MaStR 的「Bürgerwindpark Norddeich」是 Norddeich 2015–2016 年的 5 部 Enercon E-92（11.75 MW）；GEM 的 Schülp（wpd，2014 年 5 部 E-70）、Büttler Balje（Friedrichsgabekoog，2014–2015 年 5 部 E-82）與 Wesselburener Deichhausen（2014 年 5 部 E-82）都是別的機組：不同風場',
         'MaStR’s “Bürgerwindpark Norddeich” is 5 Enercon E-92 at Norddeich from 2015–2016 (11.75 MW); GEM’s Schülp (wpd, 5 E-70 of 2014), Büttler Balje (Friedrichsgabekoog, 5 E-82 of 2014–2015) and Wesselburener Deichhausen (5 E-82 of 2014) are other turbines: different farms',
         'https://www.marktstammdatenregister.de/MaStR/Datendownload'),
Büttler Balje: no change (turbines_de.json already holds MaStR’s “WP Büttler Balje”: 5 Enercon E-82 E2 of Dec 2014 – Feb 2015 plus one 1994 NTK 300 of the same company).
note_zh: Schülp：GEM（12 MW、2014 年、wpd）取自 wpd 的參考案例「Wind farm Schülp，2014 年，5 部 Enercon E-70，11.50 MW」（另有「Schülp II，2016 年，1 部 E-70，2.30 MW」）。MaStR 把這 5 部分成兩群：「Windpark Schülp」2 部 E-70 EP4（2014-03／04）與「Windpark Schülp III」3 部 E-70（2014-03／04），後者另有 2016-03-08 的 1 部 E70（＝Schülp II）；每部各有自己的營運公司（wpd 逐部出售的常見做法）。現在 turbines_de.json 對到的是 1994–2010 年的 8 部（WP Schülp Groth Hagge 等，別的機組）。Büttler Balje：GEM（12 MW、2015）對到 MaStR「WP Büttler Balje」，5 部 Enercon E-82 E2（2014-12 至 2015-02）加同一公司 1994 年的 1 部 NTK 300，沒有錯。MaStR 的「Bürgerwindpark Norddeich」是 Norddeich 的 5 部 Enercon E-92（2015-12 的 1 部、2016-03 的 4 部，同一家營運公司），型號與年份都和這三筆 GEM 不同，是另一座。
note_en: Schülp: GEM (12 MW, 2014, wpd) comes from wpd’s reference list, “Wind farm Schülp, 2014, 5 Enercon E-70, 11.50 MW” (plus “Schülp II, 2016, 1 E-70, 2.30 MW”). MaStR splits these five into two groups: “Windpark Schülp”, 2 E-70 EP4 (March/April 2014), and “Windpark Schülp III”, 3 E-70 (March/April 2014), the latter also holding one E70 of 8 March 2016 (= Schülp II); each turbine has its own operating company (wpd usually sells turbines one by one). turbines_de.json now matches 8 units of 1994–2010 (WP Schülp Groth Hagge and others: other turbines). Büttler Balje: GEM (12 MW, 2015) matches MaStR’s “WP Büttler Balje”, 5 Enercon E-82 E2 (Dec 2014 – Feb 2015) plus a 1994 NTK 300 of the same company, which is right. MaStR’s “Bürgerwindpark Norddeich” is 5 Enercon E-92 at Norddeich (1 in December 2015, 4 in March 2016, one operating company); model and years differ from all three GEM records, so it is a different farm.
why: wpd reference list (GEM's source) + MaStR unit list with operator numbers.

note_en: GEM’s Lichtenau (11 MW, 1997, operator RWE): the year and the ‘exact’ point 51.6402, 8.9306 come from MaStR and are a single Enercon E-40 of 22 Dec 1997 (unit name “41031_Lichtenau”, SEE941109269090); capacity and operator come from The Wind Power’s Lichtenau page (128 MW in 27 parts), whose part 15 is “18 Enercon E40/500, 9,000 kW, developer Winkra, operator RWE”. In MaStR the E-40 connected on 19–23 Dec 1997 carry the consecutive unit names 41017–41035 (4 dismantled), matching those 18; the 12 still operating are in MaStR’s “Lichtenau” group (26 units, 14.52 MW, 1997–2000, which also holds other owners’ units: WERA’s 4 Nordex N43, WMK’s V44/S46/S31 and others), the rest in small groups such as “41032” and “41018”. MaStR’s “Windpark Asseln” (10 units, 10.75 MW) belongs to a different company, Asselner Windkraft: E-40 serials 41075–41081 (January 1998), the 1998 E-66 (The Wind Power part 2: E66/1500, operator Asselner Windkraft GmbH) and units added 2001–2020, under the same operator number as the “Asselner Windpark” group that GEM’s “Asselner wind farm” matches. So Windpark Asseln is not GEM’s Lichtenau; but GEM’s 11 MW fits no set (RWE part 9 MW, MaStR “Lichtenau” group 14.52 MW), and MaStR now registers those E-40 under two operators (ABR997608402803 and Asselner Windkraft’s ABR948908589176), so the MANUAL choice is left to the main session.
why: No owner, municipal or press source states which turbines make up GEM's 11 MW; the serial-number reading of MaStR unit names (41017–41035 = the 18 RWE/Winkra E-40) is an inference. MaStR operator numbers are from the EinheitenWind export.

item: 2. Poland: Baltica I (GEM) vs Baltica 1 (2026 compilation)
farm: Baltica I Offshore wind farm / Baltica 1
proposal:
farm_cleanup.py RULES:
    dup('POL', 'Baltica 1', N, ('Baltica I Offshore wind farm', G),
        '2026 整理清單的 Baltica 1 就是 GEM 的 Baltica I（PGE 的 Elektrownia Wiatrowa Baltica-1，896 MW）；GEM 的座標在環評決定所寫的 POM.60.E 海域內，清單的概略座標在海域外約 23 km',
        'The compilation’s Baltica 1 is GEM’s Baltica I (PGE’s Elektrownia Wiatrowa Baltica-1, 896 MW); GEM’s point lies inside sea area POM.60.E named in the environmental decision, while the compilation’s approximate point is about 23 km outside it',
        'https://www.gov.pl/attachment/d17bdc47-d1be-49f9-a810-2949be7213b4'),
    fix('POL', 'Baltica I Offshore wind farm', G,
        '2025 年 12 月 17 日波蘭首次離岸風電差價合約競標落選（PGE 得標的是 Baltica 9）；原訂 2032 年底商轉以得標為前提，之後沒有新的預定年；由 PGE 集團（PGE Baltica）開發',
        'Lost Poland’s first offshore wind CfD auction on 17 December 2025 (PGE won with Baltica 9 instead); the end-2032 commissioning target depended on winning it, and no new date has been given; developed by the PGE Group (PGE Baltica)',
        'https://globenergia.pl/wyniki-aukcji-offshore-jeden-projekt-nie-uzyskal-wsparcia/', year=0, owner='PGE Baltica (PGE Group)', note=True),
note_zh: 同一案：兩筆都是 PGE 的 896 MW Baltica 1（專案公司 Elektrownia Wiatrowa Baltica-1 sp. z o.o.）。位置：環保總署（GDOŚ）2026-08-12 的上訴決定寫明風場在中部淺灘（Ławica Środkowa）東側、離岸約 75 km、斯沃金諾與文巴（Łeba）外海、距波蘭與瑞典專屬經濟區界線 550 m，面積 85.53 km²，位於海域空間計畫的 POM.60.E 區。EMODnet 的 POM.60.E 範圍（PZP_60，900 MW）是 55.48–55.73°N、17.13–17.83°E：GEM 的點（55.56, 17.53，概略）在區內，清單的點（55.35, 16.9）在區外約 23 km，所以保留 GEM 那筆（座標仍標概略）。商轉年：PGE 原說若在 2025 年競標拿到差價合約就在 2032 年底前商轉，但 2025-12-17 的競標它落選（得標 Baltica 9、Baltic East、Bałtyk I），PGE Baltica 2026 年 6 月的簡報把它列在尚未有差價合約的專案、沒有預定年，因此 year=0（狀態維持前期開發：已有設置許可、環評決定與併網合約）。GEM 寫的業主含 Ørsted，但各篇只說由 PGE 集團開發（Ørsted 是 Baltica 2、3 的夥伴）。Baltica 2：資料裡只有 GEM 的「Baltica II Offshore wind farm」（1,500 MW、興建中、2027）一筆，清單的 Baltica 2 已併進這筆（帶入 SG 14-236 DD 與 FID 註記），舊的 210 MW「EW Baltica 2」已不存在；附近的 Bałtyk 2、Baltica III、Freeboard I 等都是別的專案。PGE Baltica 2026 年簡報也寫 Baltica 2 約 1.5 GW、2027 年商轉，與這筆一致，不需規則。
note_en: Same project: both are PGE’s 896 MW Baltica 1 (project company Elektrownia Wiatrowa Baltica-1 sp. z o.o.). Position: the GDOŚ appeal decision of 12 Aug 2026 places the farm on the eastern side of the Middle Bank (Ławica Środkowa), about 75 km off the coast level with Smołdzino and Łeba, 550 m from the Polish–Swedish EEZ boundary, 85.53 km², inside maritime spatial plan area POM.60.E. EMODnet’s POM.60.E polygon (PZP_60, 900 MW) spans 55.48–55.73°N, 17.13–17.83°E: GEM’s point (55.56, 17.53, approximate) is inside it, the compilation’s (55.35, 16.9) about 23 km outside, so GEM’s record is kept (still flagged approximate). Year: PGE said it would commission by end-2032 if it won a CfD in the 2025 auction, but it lost on 17 Dec 2025 (winners Baltica 9, Baltic East and Bałtyk I), and PGE Baltica’s June 2026 presentation lists it among projects still preparing for a CfD auction, with no date, hence year=0 (status stays pre-construction: location permit, environmental decision and connection agreement in hand). GEM’s owner includes Ørsted, but every source says it is developed by the PGE Group (Ørsted is the partner in Baltica 2 and 3). Baltica 2: the data hold a single record, GEM’s “Baltica II Offshore wind farm” (1,500 MW, under construction, 2027), into which the compilation’s Baltica 2 already merged (bringing SG 14-236 DD and the FID note); the old 210 MW “EW Baltica 2” is gone, and nearby Bałtyk 2, Baltica III, Freeboard I and others are different projects. PGE Baltica’s 2026 presentation also gives Baltica 2 about 1.5 GW and commissioning in 2027, matching the record, so no rule is needed.
why: GDOŚ decision (gov.pl attachment) gives the area; EMODnet Human Activities WFS (windfarmspoly, Poland) gives the POM.60.E polygon used for the inside/outside test. No official post-auction COD exists.

then re-run python3 tools/build_live_units.py and python3 tools/build_generation.py (Gullen Range keeps only GULLRWF1, 165 MW vs record 165.5; Biala gets GULLRWF2, about 110 MW vs record 111).
note_zh: Open Electricity（原 OpenNEM）的 Biala 頁列出這座風場唯一的機組是 GULLRWF2（107 MW，風力，「Biala Wind Farm」），Gullen Range 頁只列 GULLRSF1（10 MW 太陽光電）與 GULLRWF1（161 MW 風力）。這與上一輪的線索一致：AEMO 2020-21 邊際損失係數報告在 2020 年 7 月新增「Gullen Range 2 Wind Farm」（GULLRWF2，NGUR3G，與 Gullen Range 同在 NGUR 節點）；Biala 風場（BJCE、約 110 MW、31 部，2020 年首度發電）以地下輸電線接到 Gullen Range 的變電所，變電所 2020 年為 Biala 擴建。所以 AEMO 的 GULLRWF2 就是 Biala，即時出力與 AEMO 實測發電量都應掛在本站的「Biala wind farm」，不再算進 Gullen Range。
note_en: Open Electricity’s (formerly OpenNEM) Biala page lists the farm’s only unit as GULLRWF2 (107 MW, wind, “Biala Wind Farm”), and its Gullen Range page lists only GULLRSF1 (10 MW solar) and GULLRWF1 (161 MW wind). This fits round 12’s lead: AEMO’s 2020-21 loss-factor report added a “Gullen Range 2 Wind Farm” connection point (GULLRWF2, NGUR3G, at Gullen Range’s NGUR node) in July 2020, and Biala Wind Farm (BJCE, about 110 MW, 31 turbines, first power in 2020) connects by an underground line to the Gullen Range substation, which was extended for Biala in 2020. So AEMO’s GULLRWF2 is Biala: its live output and AEMO measured generation belong to the site’s “Biala wind farm”, not Gullen Range.
why: New route vs round 12: OpenElectricity facility pages (openelectricity.org.au/facility/BIALAWF and /GULLRGWF) are server-rendered and quotable; their public geojson (data.openelectricity.org.au/v3/geo/au_facilities.json) also gives Biala 110.67 MW in 31 units of 3.57 MW and Gullen Range 165 MW wind + 10 MW solar.
